  WHY: Violates the append-only contract documented in the anchor comment at line 152, which explicitly states "Parallel orchestrator sub-issues: append new env-var bullets to the bottom of this list under this anchor. Do NOT reorder existing bullets or reflow paragraphs — parallel edits that rewrite existing bullets here cause merge conflicts."
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2209-2288 | severity=1 | confidence=1

  PROBLEM: `set +e` without explicit restoration

  WHY: If critical tools fail to install, later validation can fail with less clear errors instead of surfacing the dependency problem immediately
